I am an undergraduate researcher in Statistics at Jeonbuk National University,
preparing to apply to PhD programs in Statistics and Biostatistics. My work sits
at the intersection of statistical methodology and health data science.

My current interests include **biostatistics**, **machine learning for healthcare**,
**electronic health records (EHR)**, **clinical prediction modeling**, and
**statistical network analysis**. I am particularly interested in methods that
remain reliable when they are moved outside the setting in which they were
developed — across hospitals, across countries, and across populations — and in
understanding when apparent predictive gains are artifacts of data collection
rather than genuine signal.

## Research interests

- **Biostatistics** — study design and inference for observational health data
- **Machine learning for healthcare** — evaluation, calibration, and generalization
- **Electronic health records** — multi-site and multi-country EHR data
- **Clinical prediction modeling** — transfer learning and target adaptation
- **Evidence synthesis** — systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical trials
- **Statistical network analysis** — community detection in heterogeneous networks

See the [Research](research.qmd) page for current projects.
